issuer: the state traffic department (Departamento Estadual de Trânsito, DETRAN) of Ceará
note: Read 2026-10-30. The Brazilian Traffic Code (Lei 9.503/1997 as amended, the Chamber of Deputies' updated text) sets the licence's age and term for every state: a candidate must be criminally liable (Art. 140), which the Constitution (Art. 228) puts at 18; a candidate who passes gets a Permissão para Dirigir valid for one year, and the full Carteira Nacional de Habilitação at the end of that year if no serious offence was committed (Art. 148), so the full licence is held from 19; the medical examination, and with it the licence, is renewed every 10 years under 50 (Art. 147, as Lei 14.071/2020 wrote it). The fees are each state's; Ceará's weren't read (the DETRAN's own pages weren't reached), so the fee is null. The Permissão para Dirigir isn't held. The identity card is the ids engine's.

sources.title: Lei nº 9.503, de 23 de setembro de 1997 (Código de Trânsito Brasileiro), norma atualizada, Câmara dos Deputados

I - a cada 10 (dez) anos, para condutores com idade inferior a 50 (cinquenta) anos;
